name: sve-editor-android
description: The SVE Website Editor as an Android app (the same screens as editor/ui, wrapped with Capacitor).

scripts.sync: npm run copy && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../SVE-Editor.apk && echo 'APK: editor/android/SVE-Editor.apk'
